questions.markdown:
By means of the DFT and IDFT, determine the response of the FIR filter with impulse response

$$
h(n)=\{1, 3, 5\}
$$

to the input sequence

$$
x(n)=\{1, 3, 3, 1\}.
$$
State and prove circular time shifting property of Discrete Fourier Transform.

If 

$$
x(n)=\{2, 0, 2, 0\},
$$

 determine $X(2)$ using Goertzel Algorithm.

Compute the 8-point DFT of the following sequence using DIT - FFT algorithm. 

$$
x(n)=\{1,1,1,0,0,0,0,0\}
$$

Consider a three stage FIR lattice structure having the coefficients $K_1=0.65$, $K_2=0.5$ and $K_3=0.9$.

Find its impulse response and direct form structure.

Draw the direct form structure for linear phase FIR filter having impulse response 

$$
h(n)=\{1, 2, 2, 1\}
$$

The desired frequency response of a low pass filter is given by:

$$
H_d(e^{j\omega})=e^{-j3\omega}\quad \text{for } |\omega|\le 3\pi/4
$$

$$
H_d(e^{j\omega})=0\quad \text{for } 3\pi/4\le |\omega|\le \pi
$$

Determine the frequency response of the linear phase FIR filter if hamming window is used.

Certain 7-length linear phase FIR has two of the zeros of its system function located at $z_1=0.25$ and $z_2=0.5e^{j2\pi/3}$. Determine the other zeroes and write the corresponding system function $H(z)$.
With reference to designing FIR filters using window, illustrate with suitable spectral plots, the effect of tapering the window function on the frequency response of desired filter.

A digital low-pass filter is required to meet the following specifications:

Passband ripple $\le 2$ dB.
Passband edge = 4 kHz.
Stopband attenuation $\ge 20$ dB.
Stopband edge = 8 kHz.
Sampling frequency = 24 kHz.

The filter is to be designed using impulse invariance technique on an analog system function.
Determine the order and pole locations for the Chebyshev filter design.
For the filter designed in Q4A, determine the analog system function $H(s)$.
Convert the analog filter of Q4B to digital by using impulse invariance technique.

Draw the lattice ladder structure for the IIR system defined by the following system function:

$$
H(z)=\frac{8-4z^{-1}+11z^{-2}}{1-\frac{5}{4}z^{-1}+\frac{3}{4}z^{-2}-\frac{1}{8}z^{-3}}
$$

Transform a single pole lowpass filter with the system function given below having $\Omega_P=500\pi$ into a bandpass filter with upper and lower edge frequencies $2000\pi$ and $1000\pi$ respectively.

$$
H(s)=\frac{\Omega_P}{s+\Omega_P}
$$
Describe the spectral leakage and spectral resolution problems occurring in the estimation of spectra from finite duration observation of signals.
